The following events took place in '''3623 BBY'''.<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.5}}</ref>

==Events==
*The [[Eternal Alliance]] [[Mission to Hidden Chain Ship|recovered]] [[Darth Nul's holocron]] from the [[Hidden Chain]] and destroyed its [[Holocron Machine]].<ref name="TOR:Sunder">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Sundering|[[Carrick Station]]}}</ref>
*[[Darth Malgus]] is [[Malgus's escape|released]] from his prison by [[Mandalore the Avenger]] in an effort to stop the [[Hidden Chain]].<ref name="TOR:Sunder" />
*Shae Vizla's mercenary team [[Attack on a Hidden Chain base|attacks]] a Hidden Chain base on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Galactic Threads">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Galactic Threads|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>
*The Eternal Alliance sends a reconnaissance team to [[Mission to the Emperor's Fortress (Third Galactic War)|investigate]] the [[Emperor's Fortress]] on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]].<ref name="Dark Heart Ilum">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Dark Heart of the Fortress|[[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]}}</ref>
